conceptual_statement: Oregon’s strongest Trust Hub evidence is a CCB credential snapshot plus a separate BCD specialty-licensing layer, an official ODOT authorized household-goods certificate list that is not USDOT/MC authority, ODHS care-setting/inspection/violation/regulatory-action evidence that must not be added across NF/ALF/RCF/AFH or ODHS/OHA/CMS, 2025 HMDA Oregon property applications that are not lenders, DFR insurance complaint/exam/order evidence that is not an insurer census, and IAPD state-IA/ERA/notice/principal-office lenses that cannot collapse into one adviser total. Organizations and evidence records stay separate. Missing, restricted, and search-only sources are unknown — not zero.

release_gate.rule: All six specialist /oregon pages must return HTTP 200 as intended state intelligence pages, indexable and self-canonical, before Ask /oregon is indexable. Any one specialist failure fails the gate. Do not weaken the gate. Portland/Multnomah/local routes are not published.

intelligence_strip.grain: Distinct license_number in CCB Active Licenses. Supporting: 56,172 CCB rows. Not 45,501 contractor companies. BCD business 5,562, person 33,844, and inspector 8,553 credentials are not added to CCB.
Official ODOT CCD authorized-list certificate IDs. Certificate is not USDOT and not MC. Local cartage and other-than-local overlap. Complaint and enforcement bulk remain unacquired.

intelligence_strip.display: 128 NF · 240 ALF · 332 RCF · 1,580 AFH open ODHS settings
intelligence_strip.grain: Open ODHS license classes. Do not add them. OHA HHA 66 and hospice 74 are not CMS Home Health 51 or CMS Hospice 66. Matching 128 ODHS NF and CMS NH counts is not a CCN bridge.
County-market property geography. Not lenders. Supporting: 89,073 originations and 22,290 denials. Current DFR/NMLS company, MLO, and servicer rosters remain OPEN_SEARCH_ONLY.

Name-only complaint tables. Not Oregon insurers. Supporting: 738 insurance-native order documents / 726 distinct cases. Agency, producer, and authorized-insurer universes remain OPEN_SEARCH_ONLY. DFR Complaint Index is not a Trust Score.

IAPD APPROVED state IA. Supporting: 26 ERA, 2,262 notice filings, 167 principal-office overlay. Do not add these populations. Principal office is not registration. Notice filing is not state IA. ERA is not an RIA.

what_makes_oregon_different: Contractor: Oregon uses CCB credential evidence plus BCD specialty licensing, but credentials, persons, businesses, and inspectors remain different grains. Current complaint/adverse bulk remains incomplete.
Move: Oregon has a clean ODOT authorized HHG certificate list, but the certificate is not USDOT/MC authority and state complaint/enforcement bulk is not acquired.
Senior: Oregon has strong ODHS facility/inspection/violation/regulatory-action data, but care classes and ODHS/OHA/CMS universes remain separate.
Lender: Oregon has good 2025 HMDA market evidence and DFR mortgage-order context, while the current DFR/NMLS company/MLO/servicer rosters remain search-only.
Insurance: Oregon has unusually strong DFR complaint, examination, and order evidence, while current agency/producer/authorized-insurer licensing universes remain search-only.
Investor: Oregon has strong IAPD registration/reporting lenses plus DFR securities orders, but principal office, state IA, ERA, and federal notice filings cannot be collapsed.

contractor.grain_note: CCB row is not a contractor company. BCD business is not BCD person and not inspector. License credential is not a unique company. Do not add these classes.

move.grain_note: Oregon certificate is not USDOT and not MC. Local cartage and other-than-local overlap. Complaint intake is not a complaint dataset. Enforcement framework is not an enforcement case.

senior.grain_note: NF != ALF != RCF != AFH. ODHS != OHA != CMS. Inspection != complaint. Violation row != facility. Regulatory-action document != provider. Matching 128 NF/CMS NH counts is not a CCN bridge.

lender.grain_note: Canonical consumer HMDA scalar is the county-market 146,902 applications, not the 145,271 LEI-cell total. Application != lender. LEI != Oregon mortgage license. FDIC bank != DFR mortgage company. OHCS participant != statewide license.

insurance.grain_note: Agency != producer != insurer. License != appointment. Complaint != violation. Complaint Index != Trust Score. Market-conduct exam != discipline. Financial exam != enforcement. 738 documents != 726 matters.

investor.grain_note: Principal office != Oregon registration. State IA != ERA != notice filing. Firm != individual. 431 documents != 394 matters. Do not sum 167 + 335 + 26 + 2,262.

CROSS_HUB_RECORD_TOTAL.explanation: Oregon CCB credentials, ODHS care settings, ODOT mover certificates, HMDA applications, insurance complaint/order/exam observations, and IAPD registration/reporting lenses have incompatible grains. Ask does not publish an Oregon-records total.

NEW_PUBLIC_RESEARCH_SURFACES.explanation: Six specialist /oregon pages plus Ask /oregon. Page/surface count only — not a business, record, provider, or license count. 7 surfaces != 7 providers.
